basic_details.scholarship_name: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science (SCS) Graduate Assistantships
basic_details.offering_entity: School of Computer Science (SCS), Carnegie Mellon University
basic_details.major_restrictions: Computer Science Department (CSD), Robotics Institute (RI), Machine Learning Department (MLD), Language Technologies Institute (LTI), Human-Computer Interaction Institute (HCII), Software and Societal Systems Department (S3D), and Computational Biology Department (CBD).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted PhD students receive full multi-year graduate assistantship packages (~150 to 180 doctoral fellowships across SCS annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on absolute merit; Pakistani scholars in computing, robotics, and machine learning regularly win full CMU SCS doctoral funding (~3 to 6 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of doctoral program (typically 5 to 6 years of guaranteed support)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: $45,000 to $49,000 / year (approx. $3,750 to $4,080 / month; ~PKR 1,040,000 to 1,135,000 / month) 12-month living stipend plus 100% full tuition waiver and comprehensive CMU health insurance

nationality_requirements: Open to international students worldwide including Pakistan as well as U.S. citizens/PR
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; selection based strictly on exceptional computing research ability and technical excellence.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's or 18-year Master's degree with exceptional academic standing (equivalent to minimum GPA 3.85+ / 4.00 or top 2% of graduating class) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate/graduate GPA of 3.85 / 4.0; admitted CMU SCS doctoral candidates are evaluated on published research impact.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering, robotics, or related quantitative computing field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree before September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Peer-reviewed research publications in top-tier computing venues (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, SIGCOMM, OSDI, POPL) strongly expected.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT minimum 100 (subscores 25+), IELTS Academic minimum 7.5, or Duolingo 125+ mandatory for CMU SCS.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to a Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science PhD program.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Coordinated with CMU SCS standard multi-year doctoral funding guarantee.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full Carnegie Mellon University doctoral tuition and required student activities fees covered for all years of study.

admission_application_fee.details: CMU SCS graduate application fee of $80 to $125; fee waivers available for eligible applicants via SCS portal.
admission_application_fee.amount: $80 to $125 (~PKR 22,000 to 35,000) application fee (fee waiver available)

accommodation.details: Private apartments in Pittsburgh neighborhoods (Shadyside, Squirrel Hill, Oakland) funded comfortably via monthly living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~$750 to $1,200 / month rent in Pittsburgh)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month living stipend of $45,000 to $49,000 / year ($3,750 to $4,080 / month; ~PKR 1,040,000 to 1,135,000 / month) disbursed semimonthly.

airfare.details: Relocation flights to Pittsburgh are self-funded or subsidized by departmental relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: U.S. F-1 Student Visa application fee (~$185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (~$350) paid to U.S. government.

health_insurance.details: Carnegie Mellon University Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP through Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield) 100% covered for all funded doctoral fellows.

food_allowance.details: Dining and groceries covered through monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: World-class compute infrastructure (Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center, SCS clusters), dedicated laboratory workstations, and university library privileges included.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: SCS departmental and advisor travel funds provide up to $2,500 to $4,500 per year for presenting peer-reviewed research papers at conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: CMU ID card provides 100% free unlimited public transit on all Pittsburgh Regional Transit (PRT) buses and light rail ('T').

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world #1 computer science powerhouse (Carnegie Mellon University).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: CSRankings #1 globally for Computer Science, Robotics, AI, and Software Engineering; U.S. News #1 in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Programming Languages.
available_majors: PhD in Language and Information Technologies (LTI)
Joint PhD in Neural Computation and Machine Learning
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 5 to 6 years of full-time doctoral study and research
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 3.85+ GPA, verified transcripts, TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.5+, three academic letters of recommendation, CV detailing research outputs, and statement of purpose.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: CMU SCS receives over 6,000 doctoral applications for ~150 spots (overall acceptance rate < 3%); having published papers in top ACM/IEEE conferences is the hallmark of successful applicants.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus application essays on specific research problems, algorithms, or systems; reference ongoing research in specific SCS institutes (RI, MLD, CSD, LTI).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science Graduate Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the CMU SCS application portal, choose target doctoral programs (up to 3 programs under a single application fee), upload transcripts, statement of purpose, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore CMU SCS department profiles and recent publications in your field of interest.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.5+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on CMU SCS portal by early December deadline.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, statement of purpose, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Three academic referees submit letters directly into the CMU SCS system.
Step 6: Departmental faculty admissions committee reviews applications and selects doctoral candidates.
Step 7: Successful applicants receive formal admission offer with full multi-year guaranteed funding package in February.
Step 8: Accept offer by April 15, receive I-20, and apply for U.S. F-1 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Universal Doctoral Funding: 100% of admitted CMU SCS PhD students receive full multi-year funding guarantees without separate financial aid application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (approx. 1,000 words) describing academic trajectory, research questions, proposed methodologies, and alignment with CMU faculty.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Incorporated into statement of purpose; publications or code repositories linked in CV.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, conference presentations, awards, and technical proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews via Zoom with prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and coding/algorithmic acumen.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT 100+ or IELTS 7.5+ mandatory; GRE optional/not required by most SCS departments.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $80 to $125 (approx. PKR 22,000 to 35,000; fee waiver available upon request)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official HEC verified transcripts required upon final matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via CMU SCS application portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for Fall semester entry; applications strictly due in early December.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 55% (Demonstrated research originality, peer-reviewed publications, algorithmic problem solving)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SCS Faculty Admissions Committees and Department Chairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review prioritizing research depth, originality, peer-reviewed outputs, and scientific match with CMU research laboratories.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official CMU SCS website at cs.cmu.edu.
CMU never works with commercial recruiting agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of $80 to $125 is paid directly through the secure portal; fee waivers are available for eligible applicants.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies cannot influence CMU admissions; fraudulent applications result in permanent bans.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: CMU CS PhD students must pay tuition. Reality: 100% of admitted CMU SCS doctoral students receive full tuition coverage, health insurance, and a generous 12-month living stipend ($45k-$49k/yr).
Myth: You need a master's degree to apply. Reality: Students holding a 4-year Bachelor's degree are directly eligible to apply to CMU PhD programs.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend values; current verified CMU SCS 12-month doctoral stipend is $45,000 to $49,000.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic progress and minimum B+ (3.3/4.0) average in graduate coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Pittsburgh and active contribution to research laboratory projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews (Black Friday review) and thesis proposal defense administered by the department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistant or Research Assistant duties are integrated into doctoral training; outside employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for 3-year U.S. STEM OPT work authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated departmental research or teaching duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student withdraws or fails academic milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program committee and faculty supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Guaranteed funding extends through the full standard duration of doctoral study (typically 5 to 6 years).
